fieldValues.title: Each new source starts from what the series left open
fieldValues.move: After each new source is processed, an update protocol gives every item earlier documents left open exactly one follow-up, restates each subject's standing (superseding the last), and proposes subject changes for a person to accept; history reaches the stage through subjects and the relation graph, with text search only as the fallback.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not curate the subject list; a person still has to, and a misfiled topic still breaks a chain until accepted. Does not solve memory beyond one group's series.
fieldValues.falsifier: Over four consecutive meetings, open items still go without a follow-up, or the follow-ups the process writes are mostly wrong (marked not mentioned when the meeting did deal with them).
fieldValues.return_when: The series is long enough that subjects themselves need summarising.
